description: Partial route update (only sent fields change; an OMITTED field is left alone). On a nullable field (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), null CLEARS it to its default — unlike omitting it. To set redirectTo/redirectStatus, send purpose: "redirect" in the SAME call (only what's sent is checked, even on an existing redirect) or it 400s invalid_body.

contentKey.description: Explicit content key (default: path-derived). null restores the default (undoes a prior set on PATCH).

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes (0.56e M2); kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

goalId.description: Optional dotsy conversion goal; omit when tracking in external analytics.

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): the daily sweep may auto-promote a ≥95% winner or auto-end keep-A after 30 days. Prefer start_test; kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

id.description: Stable experiment slug — cookie namespace; unique per site forever.
Variant arm id — default "a" / "b" on create.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site (pgg_…). Omit when signed in with OAuth.

lang.description: Page language, e.g. "es", "pt-BR". null clears (folder or main language applies).

layout.description: Layout NAME, bare ("default" for layouts/default.html), not the file key. Must already exist (400 layout_not_found). null removes it.

noindex.description: Exclude from sitemap/RSS; inject noindex meta (0.69).

preserveQuery.description: Append the visitor's query string to the redirect target (default true on a redirect). null clears the override.

redirectStatus.description: 301 permanent / 302 or 308 temporary (default 301 on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

redirectTo.description: Root-relative redirect target (/…). Required when purpose is "redirect"; null clears it once purpose is no longer "redirect".

translationKey.description: Pages sharing a key are translations of each other. null clears.

name: patch_route
